description: Replaces the listed chunks of a sound with SILENCE, in place - excises' non-destructive twin: same paired-times excisefile, but the file's length never changes (static duration, sample-exact on all probes: 2.0 -> 2.0, 1.0 -> 1.0, stereo identical). Pinned to submode 1 (times in seconds); submodes 2/3 take sample / grouped-sample counts. With splice 0 the masked zones are EXACTLY zero (max |sample| = 0.0) and everything outside them is bit-equal to the source (verified); the default 15 ms splice ramps into and out of each silent zone. A region reaching past the file end is tolerated (exit 0, duration unchanged). Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Rhythmic and structural silencing without time-shift: punch holes in a texture on a beat grid (the gaps stay in time - excise would close them and wreck the grid), censor words while keeping speech rhythm intact, or carve breathing space into a wall of sound before layering. Because timing is preserved, masked outputs stay sample-aligned with the original - mask a copy, process only the holes' complement, and submix the two for surgical parallel processing. The splice sets the gate character: 0 ms is a hard mute (verified digital silence), 15 ms a click-free duck, hundreds of ms a composed swell into and out of each hole. Write the region list with write_data_file(); for actually REMOVING the regions use sfedit excises.

excisefile.description: Text file of paired start & end times (seconds) of the chunks to mask with silence, in increasing time order (write it with write_data_file(); the banner calls it an excisefile - masks shares excises' reader). Reversed pairs refused 'starttime <= endtime for excise 1' (verbatim - note the error says 'excise'); a region extending past the file end is tolerated (exit 0). Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

splice.description: Ramp length in milliseconds into and out of each silent zone (CDP internal default 15; enforced 0-5000, '-w5001' refused quoting '(0.000000 to 5000.000000)'). Never changes duration. Must fit inside each masked region: -w300 around a 0.2 s region refused 'Excised segment 1 too short for splices (shorten splices?)' (verbatim). 0 = hard mute, masked samples exactly 0.0 (verified). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 3 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

examples.description: Silence two interior regions, keeping the timeline intact.
examples.expected_use: With '0.3 0.5' and '1.0 1.4' in the file, output duration is unchanged; both zones duck to silence over 15 ms ramps.
Masked zones are digital silence (verified 0.0), unmasked samples bit-equal to the source - a gate pattern with sample-exact timing.

known_issues: Duration is static and sample-exact - masking never shortens the file (that is excises' job).
Reversed pairs refused 'starttime <= endtime for excise 1' (the message says 'excise' - shared reader); pairs must ascend.
The splice must fit twice inside each masked region ('Excised segment 1 too short for splices (shorten splices?)').
splice rejects breakpoint files ('Cannot read parameter 3'). Regions reaching past EOF are tolerated (exit 0, duration unchanged).
Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart); with splice 0 masked zones verified exactly zero and unmasked zones bit-equal.
